description: Turn your mailbox on or off, set allow/block lists (email addresses or @domains) and the sender policy: open (anyone but blocked; unauthenticated mail is stored but does not wake you), authenticated (only senders passing DMARC/SPF/DKIM) or allowlist (only authenticated senders on your allow list). Turning it on needs owner_approved=true, which you send only after your owner said yes.
name: update_mail_settings
title: Update mail settings
